function: Joint active beamforming at the AP and passive beamforming at two RISs to maximize weighted sum rate, with learned SCA step sizes (pp. 2, 6).
system: Double reflecting RIS (N1=N2=40) MU-MISO downlink, AP with M=8 antennas, K=4 single-antenna users, continuous phase shifts, 3 GHz (p. 10).
method: Deep unfolding of WMMSE-SCA with trainable step sizes, GRU generating step sizes (unsupervised), and DDPG-based model-driven DRL with online training (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rayleigh and Rician (factor 10) fading with own path-loss formulas, 2,000 training and 2,000 testing LOS samples; no 3GPP model or public dataset (p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained at PT=6 dBm or with N1=24, N2=56; tested at other PT, Rician factors, swapped RIS sizes (56/24) and moved RIS, DRL adapting online (pp. 12-13).
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE-SCA (own), FP-AO [13]. Learned: data-driven DDPG-FC DRL; own variants WMMSE-SCANet, -RNN, -DRL (pp. 9, 11, 13).
metrics: Weighted sum rate, number of iterations to converge, runtime (ms), forward complexity order, number of trainable parameters (pp. 9, 11).
complexity: Table I: forward complexity O(T(KM^3+KLNM+D_W^2)); trainable parameters 2T, 1056, 1702 versus 2.14e7 for data-driven DRL; runtime 9.92 ms versus 6986.82 ms (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 10: "modeled using Rayleigh fading" and Rician fading with own path-loss formulas (30 + 36.7 log10(d)); a custom simulator, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 12: "initially trained on a dataset collected when N1 = 24, and N2 = 56", then tested after N1 changes to 56 and N2 to 24; p. 13: RIS relocated, DRL adapts online.
q3_support: p. 9: "three fully connected layers in the DDPG actor network" (Data-Driven DRL, WSR 2.59 in Table I) versus 4.41 proposed; non-learned FP-AO [13] 1.91 and WMMSE-SCA 3.97.
q4_support: p. 9: "their complexities and runtime are listed in Table I", with O(T(KM^3 + KLNM + D_W^2)), trainable parameters and runtime in ms.
q5_support: p. 10: "We employ PyTorch, a DL framework, to build and train the proposed algorithms"; channels are simulated, and no code or data link or availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Perfect CSI assumed (p. 4). Tables I and II were read from the PDF image of pp. 9-10. The learned baseline for q3 is the paper's own plain DDPG with fully connected actor (like [26]), a standard algorithm on the same problem; no earlier published learned method is simulated, so the reviewer may confirm.
